comments.author: Li Yue
comments.body:
There is no glowing area when your at sea only in land. For this kind of map use search while sailing and in chat screen will say something "further east", "further west", etc. Just follow the direction and once it says "somewhere near here" use recognition.

You need to have unlock r9 (with boost can) in order for you to get treasure.
